items.title: Repair malformed @task annotation blocks reported by lint tasks
items.context: npm run lint:tasks reports 64 errors across 11 locations. For each location, either convert explanatory @task text to non-structured prose or complete the structured annotation fields according to docs/requirements/decisions/annotation-system.md. Do not alter runtime behavior.
items.userSees: npm run lint:tasks no longer lists the 64 missing-field annotation errors; the affected @task comments are either valid structured annotations or plain explanatory comments with no runtime behavior change.

happy.desc: npm run lint:tasks reports 0 missing-field annotation errors (was 64)
All 11 affected locations have valid structured @task annotations or plain prose comments

edge.desc: Explanatory context originally in malformed annotations is preserved as prose comments, not deleted

adversarial.desc: No executable code (non-comment lines) changed beyond annotation/comment edits — git diff shows only comment-line changes

verificationEvidence.note: 0 errors reported (was 64). Task Annotation Report shows Errors: 0.
All 11 @task locations converted to prose Task comments. 8 files changed, each converting @task to Task in comment lines only.
All explanatory context preserved — only @task/@title prefixes changed to Task prose format. Full JSDoc blocks and inline comment bodies intact.
git diff shows 8 files, 12 insertions, 14 deletions — all in comment lines (// or * prefixed). No non-comment executable code changed.

items.title: Verify annotation lint and convergence become clean
items.context: After annotation cleanup, npm run lint:tasks should have 0 errors and koala convergence_check should no longer fail on code annotation compliance. Build must still pass; run focused smoke tests only if touched comments affect test-linked code paths.
items.userSees: koala convergence_check reports code annotation compliance passing instead of 64 annotation errors, while npm run lint:tasks and npm --prefix packages/main run build pass.

happy.desc: npm run lint:tasks exits 0 with no errors
koala convergence_check code annotation compliance row passes

edge.desc: npm --prefix packages/main run build exits 0 (no build regression)

adversarial.desc: No unrelated dirty or untracked files introduced by the changes (git status clean except story metadata)
docs/koala/koala-project-overview.md is unchanged (git diff shows no edits)

verificationEvidence.note: lint:tasks reports Errors: 0, Warnings: 2 (pre-existing @test warnings, not annotation errors).
convergence_check reports 代码注释合规 passed: true with 21 annotations compliant. Only failing row is Story B-407e itself (expected in DEV).
